External wrapper that releases the caller's own locked tokens via release_.

Owner-only rescue function performing an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer and checking totalBalance.

Returns this contract's token balance via token.balanceOf(this).

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the owner state variable derives from untrusted caller input.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument of token.transferFrom inside accept.
accept uses msg.sender as the token source and in the Lock event.
getTimestamp_ returns block.timestamp, making the time source miner-influenced (timestamp dependency).
accept requires _timestamp > getTimestamp_(), so unlock eligibility depends on block.timestamp.
release_ requires _curTimestamp <= getTimestamp_(), so release eligibility depends on block.timestamp.
token state variable is the target of the transferFrom call in accept.
token state variable is the target of the transfer call in release_.
token state variable is used inside contractBalance_ checks related to saveLockedERC20Tokens.
contractBalance_ reads token.balanceOf(this).
accept invokes token.transferFrom as its external token pull.
accept calls contractBalance_ before and after the transfer.
accept writes the credited amount into balance[_for][_timestamp].
The external token.transferFrom call is made before balance[_for][_timestamp] is updated, allowing a malicious token to reenter accept and double-credit balances.
accept computes totalBalance = _totalBalance.add(_value) using SafeMath addition.
release_ performs the external token.transfer payout.
release_ reduces balance[_for][_curTimestamp] via sub.
release_ computes totalBalance = totalBalance.sub(_totalValue) using SafeMath subtraction.
release delegates to the internal release_ function with msg.sender as beneficiary.
releaseForce delegates to the internal release_ function with an arbitrary _for address.
releaseForce is gated by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
saveLockedERC20Tokens performs an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer call.
saveLockedERC20Tokens requires totalBalance <= contractBalance_() after the transfer.
saveLockedERC20Tokens is gated by onlyOwner, checking msg.sender against owner.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable after an onlyOwner authorization check.
The owner state variable gates the privileged releaseForce function.
The rescue transfer is validated against the totalBalance accounting state variable.
Parameter _for flows into accept as the credited beneficiary key.
Parameter _timestamp flows into accept as the unlock timestamp key.
Parameter _tvalue flows into the token.transferFrom amount argument.
Parameter _for of release_ indexes the balance mapping and the payout target.
Parameter _timestamp array of release_ is iterated to select balances.
Parameter _value array of release_ is iterated to compute subtracted amounts.
Parameter _timestamp of release is forwarded to release_.
Parameter _value of release is forwarded to release_.
Parameter _for of releaseForce is forwarded to release_.
Parameter _timestamp of releaseForce is forwarded to release_.
Parameter _value of releaseForce is forwarded to release_.
Parameter _token is cast to IERC20 and called inside saveLockedERC20Tokens.
Parameter _to is the recipient argument of the rescue transfer call.
Parameter _amount is the amount argument of the rescue transfer call.
Parameter newOwner is written into the owner state variable in transferOwnership.
Local _contractBalance caches contractBalance_() within accept to compute the received delta.
Local _balance caches balance[_for][_timestamp] before it is credited in accept.
Local _totalBalance caches totalBalance before it is increased in accept.
Local _value holds the credited token delta written into the balance mapping in accept.
Local _len bounds the release_ loop over timestamp and value arrays.
Local _totalValue accumulates released amounts and is subtracted from totalBalance.
Local _curValue holds the per-timestamp locked balance before subtraction in release_.
Local _curTimestamp selects the balance slot inside the release_ loop.
Local _subValue is the per-iteration amount subtracted in release_.
Local _now caches getTimestamp_() for maturity checks in release_.
Local i is the loop counter of the release_ iteration.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _for of accept is only meaningful inside the accept function and should be folded into it.
Parameter _timestamp of accept is only meaningful inside the accept function and should be folded into it.
Parameter _tvalue directly feeds the unsafe token.transferFrom call and should be absorbed there.
Parameter _for of release_ is consumed only by the internal release_ logic.
Parameter _timestamp array of release_ is consumed only by the internal release_ loop.
Parameter _value array of release_ is consumed only by the internal release_ loop.
Parameter _timestamp of release is only forwarded to release_ from the release wrapper.
Parameter _value of release is only forwarded to release_ from the release wrapper.
Parameter _for of releaseForce exists only to select the forced release target.
Parameter _timestamp of releaseForce is only forwarded to release_.
Parameter _value of releaseForce is only forwarded to release_.
Parameter _token is only used to build the external call inside saveLockedERC20Tokens.
Parameter _to is the recipient argument of the unsafe external transfer call.
Parameter _amount is the amount argument of the unsafe external transfer call.
Parameter newOwner exists solely to update the owner variable in transferOwnership.
Local _contractBalance is a temporary cache used only within accept.
Local _balance is a temporary cache of the balance mapping used only within accept.
Local _totalBalance is a temporary cache of totalBalance used only within accept.
Local _value is a temporary computed token delta used only within accept.
Local _len is a loop bound used only inside release_.
Local _totalValue is an accumulator used only inside release_.
Local _curValue is a per-iteration cache used only inside release_.
Local _curTimestamp is a per-iteration cache used only inside release_.
Local _subValue is a per-iteration cache used only inside release_.
Local _now caches the timestamp getter inside release_.
Local i is the loop counter used only inside release_.
